# Suppression registry — the ONE inventory of every test-suppression escape hatch
# (test-platform spec Phase 1 / WP1.2, design 2026-09-15 §Phase 1). Format
# generalises .github/flake-allowlist.yml: every entry carries owner, tracking,
# expires, reason. Scripts/enforcement: suppression-census.py counts the tree,
# ratchet-check.py (WP1.3) fails CI when a census category outgrows the registry,
# and an EXPIRED entry fails CI naming its owner (WP1.4) — nothing lapses quietly.
#
# ids are minted by suppression-census.py --locations and must match the census
# byte-for-byte: pytest decorators `file::test_name` (line-drift-proof),
# imperative pytest.skip `file:lineno`, frontend `file::title`, and the literal
# entry paths / tree basenames / coverage-omit modules for the config categories.
#
# kind vocabulary (the spec's mandated distinction — environment probes are
# exempt; permanent TODOs are not):
#   environment  probe of what the host offers (lib missing, GPU down, DB unset,
#                file layout). Exempt: tracking null, expires null.
#   scoped       whole tree by design elsewhere (nightly-full-gate.yml,
#                validate.sh --ignore). Exempt the same way.
#   quarantine   file held out of the vitest run — red or empty, pending repair.
#                tracking R-T7-VITEST; expiry enforced.
#   todo         "not implemented yet" — a permanent TODO wearing a skip. MUST
#                carry a tracking ref (NEM-*, R-T9-*, ledger ruling, or an
#                explicit UNTRACKED:<family> marker for a real finding that no
#                Linear issue covers yet — replace markers when issues are filed).
#   flaky        recorded timing flake (sits OUTSIDE the flake-allowlist retry
#                path — a skip is not a retry; these were converted to skips).
#   retired      superseded/dead test kept in the tree. Delete-by expiry.
#   defect       suppresses a SHIPPED DEFECT pending owner ruling (R-T9 family).
#                Short expiry: the ruling or the fix must land.
#
# Generated by scripts/suppression-registry-gen.py from the census; ids and
# kinds may only change deliberately, never silently.
